description: DE single, wages + interest, standard deduction, top bracket
DE joint, both 65+: additional standard deduction and senior personal credits
working: DE AGI = 30,250 + 20,000 + 15,000 + 5,000 + 40,000 = 110,250 (no DE capital-gains preference). Standard deduction status 2 = 6,500 plus additional standard deduction 2 boxes x $2,500 = 5,000 -> 11,500. Taxable 110,250 - 11,500 = 98,750. Tax: 2,943.50 + 6.6% x (98,750 - 60,000 = 38,750) = 2,943.50 + 2,557.50 = 5,501.00. Personal credits: line 27a 2 x 110 = 220; line 27b (60 or over) 2 x 110 = 220 -> 440. Total 5,501 - 440 = 5,061. (The 60+ pension/eligible-retirement-income exclusion of up to $12,500 each is outside the spec and not applied; federal figures use the 2026 $1,650 add-ons and the $6,000 x 2 senior deduction.)
